queries_run: Celestica co-packaged optics ODM direct hyperscaler threat to EMS 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子列出客戶面臨技術快速變化（含 AI 演進）、替代品出現、低成本與開源 AI 模型競爭，可能限制客戶 AI 相關產品定價；屬一般性風險揭露，未點名特定替代技術取代 CLS 產品。
findings.excerpt: Factors that may adversely affect our customers include: rapid changes in technology (including evolving AI technologies); evolving industry standards; seasonal demand; their failure to successfully market, and/or a lack of widespread commercial acceptance of, their products and services; supply chain issues; the emergence of substitutes for products and services;

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 CLS 投資前瞻產品路線圖與設計能力，與生態夥伴合作定義未來路線，提供機櫃級平台方案。
findings.excerpt: We continue to invest in leading-edge product roadmaps and design capabilities aligned with both market standards and emerging technologies.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未發現任何來源記載有替代技術正在取代 CLS 核心產品；亦未發現超大規模客戶自建 CPO 交換器繞過 CLS 的紀錄。僅 1 次搜尋。

clues.claim: CLS 獲得超大規模客戶 CPO（共封裝光學）乙太網路交換器設計與製造專案，採 1.6T 交換晶片，預計 2027 年開始量產爬坡。
